description: Resolve an ISIN (12-character international securities identifier, e.g. "CH0038863350" or "DE0007164600") to the LEGAL ENTITY that issued the security: its LEI, registered legal name, jurisdiction, and status, via the official GLEIF ISIN-to-LEI mapping. Answers "who issued this security" / "which company is behind ISIN X" for non-US as well as US securities. An ISIN identifies one security while the issuer typically has many — the response says what it resolved TO. A valid ISIN with no mapping yet is reported as unmapped (the mapping lags new issuance), distinct from an invalid ISIN.

isin.description: 12-character ISIN, e.g. "CH0038863350" (2-letter country prefix + 9-char NSIN + check digit)

name: isin_to_lei
title: Isin To Lei
